Speaker: Glitch
Text: H-hello? Is someone there? My rendering keeps flickering. I think I'm broken.

Speaker: Mira
Text: You're a Nexus entity? What happened to you?

Speaker: Glitch
Text: The Kernel's corruption. It hit the Wastes first. Everyone else here has been overwritten. I'm the last one.

Speaker: Glitch
Text: Please — take me with you. I don't want to be overwritten too.
